desc:
🔥 Can you unlock the strongest Domain Expansion?

🤞 Train your Cursed Energy and master legendary Domain Expansions from JJK. Unlock Gojo’s Unlimited Void and Sukuna’s Malevolent Shrine, then unleash their power against tougher bosses.

🖱️ Gain +1 Cursed Energy per click and unlock powerful new Domains. Each has a unique ability and is stronger than the last.
⚔️ Fight through stages of enemies and bosses, earn Trophies and climb the leaderboard.
🥚 Hatch pets for boosts, equip auras to multiply your Cursed Energy, and rebirth to grow stronger. Your Cursed Energy keeps growing offline!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates!
